tldr: Mars through the 7th house heats up partners, close friends, clients, conflict, and attraction.
body:
When Mars moves through your 7th house, it adds heat and urgency to partners, close friends, clients, conflict, attraction, and what other people bring out in you. You may notice more through direct encounters with other people: what feels mutual, what feels unfair, and what someone else is reflecting back.

You may feel more impatient, motivated, protective, desirous, or ready to act. It can help you move something that has been stuck.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for seeing relationship patterns while they are active, not just after the fact.

The caution: Watch for reacting before you know what you are actually trying to change. The risk is making the other person the whole problem or the whole solution.

Mars moves through this house for about six weeks. Give the pressure a useful outlet. Act with a target, not just a charge.
